sections.theory:
Symptoms

Just as the causes of heart diseases are of different kinds, in the same way the symptoms of heart diseases of different kinds also appear in several ways, and only an expert physician can decide whether the symptoms confirm some disorder of the heart, or the patient has some problem related to the stomach, gall bladder, chest or nerves whose symptoms resemble heart trouble. The important symptoms are the following, which can be stated in identifying heart diseases.

Feeling severe pain and suffocation on the left side of the chest.

Shortness of breath and irregularity of the heartbeat.

A wave of pain arising in the left arm.

Diagnosis

Through the E.C.G. (Electrocardiogram) an expert doctor can examine the condition of the heart.

Through the stethoscope (Stethoscope), directly listening to the heartbeat and the sound of breathing in the chest and checking the condition of the heart.

Treatment

Only an expert physician of this field can propose treatment of heart diseases after seeing the individual condition of the patient, symptoms, results of blood tests, E.C.G. and other supporting results. Since the high level of cholesterol in the blood, narrowing and stiffening of the arteries and thickening of the blood are different symptoms, their medicines too are prescribed separately for every patient accordingly.
